question: Why is it safer for our hands to use a wooden spoon while cooking in a hot pan instead of using a metallic spoon?

options.text: Wood is a good conductor of heat and helps in cooking.
Wood adds nice flavours to the food being cooked.
Wood is an insulator and does not heat up.
Wood helps the food cook faster.

solution:
The correct answer is __**wood is an insulator and does not heat up**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wood is an insulator** and does not conduct heat well, making it safer for our hands when cooking in a hot pan.
 
• Unlike metallic spoons, wooden spoons **do not heat up quickly**, thus preventing burns and discomfort.
 
• Using a wooden spoon **reduces the risk of accidental burns** since it remains cooler to the touch compared to metal utensils.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wooden utensils are **less likely to scratch** non-stick cookware compared to metal utensils.
 
• They are also **eco-friendly** and biodegradable, making them a sustainable choice for the kitchen.
 
• Wooden spoons can be used for a variety of cooking tasks, including stirring, mixing, and serving, without affecting the taste of the food.
 
• Regular maintenance, such as oiling, can extend the lifespan of wooden utensils and keep them in good condition.
